brood_plan.description: Cerebrate produces a brood-plan decomposing work into independent strains. Parent-side dispatch only; children run the shared engine themselves. Declares every cerebrate outcome (single|multi|brood|open_questions|blocked); only brood proceeds to the brood_confirm gate — if cerebrate decides the work is single/multi, hatchery dispatch cannot proceed and surfaces to the user as blocked; open questions go to the question gate.

brood_confirm.description: Surface normalized strain task text for explicit user approval before dispatching the brood.

spawn_brood.description: Launch child overlord instances via the deterministic spawn substrate, then enter hatchery monitor mode.

question.description: Question gate: the brood plan returned open_questions. The overlord asks the user, and the answer goes back to the state that asked, in the same run: the outcome is the name of that state, which runs again with the answer. cancelled ends the run.
